items.title: Guarantees for kernel herding: ball approximation and convergence rate on the unit cube
items.author: Grünewälder, Steffen
items.work: Compressed empirical measures in finite dimensions
items.source_version: Annales Henri Lebesgue (2026), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/ahl.271
items.difficulty_reason: H2按完整RKHS-compression链保留：1704-1772由Mercer width与Lipschitz/density lower bound给population convex hull内球，对所有方向的smoothed support-function用uniform empirical concentration控制，把内球传至sample convex hull并从mean中心移到empirical mean；2903-2976再在有球/无球两事件上分别给kernel-herding O(1/t)/O(1/sqrt(t))，组合tail probability与stopping-time bound。非例行处是随机convex geometry的统一内半径控制及有限维compression，不是孤立代常数或原H3标签。CGM/regression variants及covariance工具关联原作者全源不另拆。
